data.long_meaning: The name Westbrooke is derived from Old English words 'west' meaning 'west' and 'broc' or 'brook' meaning 'a brook or stream'. The name evokes the image of a tranquil waterway situated in the western region. The name Westbrooke carries the meaning “A brook or stream in the west” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Westbrooke usually hope their child will grow to embody a brook or stream in the west and live with faith, good character and purpose.
